about: Example agent shelf (2026-10-15). Copy to <world>/ops/agent-shelf/shelf.json (or set CC_SHELF_FILE in the bridge env) and make it yours. Each agent is a kind you can raise, not a running process. runs_on is a box id from ops/box-map/boxes.json. cost is your own note, free text.

agents.name: Summarizer
agents.mission: Read one document or thread and write a short summary with the open questions.
agents.permit: any write outside the out folder

agents.name: Code reviewer
agents.mission: Review a branch for correctness bugs and report findings with file and line.
agents.permit: any push, any edit to the reviewed repo

agents.name: Literature scout
agents.mission: Find and rank papers on one question; return citations, never full texts.
agents.permit: any paid search beyond the monthly budget
